An '''artifact''' created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] was one of a set of five [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] that he used to [[Conquest of the Dromund system|conquer]] the [[Dromund system]]. The artifact eventually fell into the possession of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and was stored in their private vault on [[Elysium]]. In [[3643 BBY]] the [[Darth Nox|the apprentice]] of [[Darth Zash]] recovered the arifact, and Zash later combined it with four other artifacts to perform the [[essence transfer]] ritual in the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tulak Hord's artifact on Alderaan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission.
